interpretation: Approve the previously proposed frozen 12-case B/G meaning-utility experiment, not a production UNKNOWN-policy change or E2 capture.

failure_contract: Persist attempt identity before network dispatch. Failed, truncated, invalid, or indeterminate attempts remain explicit and cannot be retried or promoted to success.
evaluation: Generate fresh private per-case randomized arm mapping, provide only source/facts and anonymous candidates to an independent rater, lock ratings before decoding, and apply the frozen threshold without post-output case or prompt selection.
historical_authority: The original preparation plan remains an unchanged historical blocked snapshot. This separate authority opens only the specified E1 generation. Old U13/HOLDOUT and E2 gates remain closed.
